findings.title: `import(...)` in object literal still eagerly imports all apps at module evaluation time
findings.body: In `packages/app-store/index.ts`, the `appStore` object values are written as `applecalendar: import("./applecalendar")` rather than functions like `applecalendar: () => import("./applecalendar")`. Because `import(...)` is called directly when constructing the `appStore` object literal, importing `@calcom/app-store` immediately triggers dynamic imports of all 28 app packages in parallel instead of loading them lazily on demand when a specific app is accessed.

findings.title: `async` callback in `.forEach` pushes deletions after `Promise.all` has already run
findings.body: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts` around lines 458-470, `.forEach(async (credential) => { ... })` is used when cancelling remaining recurring bookings. Because `.forEach` does not await the async callback, `await getCalendar(credential)` and `await calendar?.deleteEvent(...)` suspend execution while the outer function continues synchronously to `await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` (line 652) before `apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent)` is ever reached. As a result, calendar event deletions for recurring bookings are not awaited before the handler finishes (which can terminate execution early in serverless environments), and any rejected promises inside the `forEach` callback become unhandled rejections.

findings.title: `async` callback in `forEach` inside `try/catch` will not catch errors or await completion
findings.body: In `packages/app-store/vital/lib/reschedule.ts` (lines 124-139) and `packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts` (lines 124-139), `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... })` is wrapped in a `try { ... } catch`. Because `forEach` ignores the returned promises, the `Reschedule` function does not wait for `getCalendar` or `deleteEvent`/`deleteMeeting` to complete, and any error thrown after `await getCalendar(...)` will result in an unhandled promise rejection rather than being caught by the surrounding `try/catch` block. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(async ...))` instead.
